deposits.notes:
Found by following the c041 form's shared-sample lead to related report c246, not through a repository link in c041 or a positive repository search result. c246 explicitly names this URL in its 'GenAI feedback conditions' section, PDF p. 5 (printed p. 169). It is the third-party Mr. Ranedeer tutor used in the personalized condition of S1; neither report identifies an archived experimental version of this repository, so studies_covered is unclear. The GitHub web page and https://api.github.com/repos/JushBJJ/Mr.-Ranedeer-AI-Tutor/git/trees/HEAD?recursive=1 both returned HTTP 200. The tree response had truncated=false and SHA ea29bcf196d28e70eb31100d00b108ebbacceb96; all 12 blob files are listed. Read README.md, My_Information.txt and GPT_Prompt.txt and inspected Mr_Ranedeer.txt in memory at that SHA; all four raw-file requests returned HTTP 200 and their byte lengths matched the tree. These are general tutor prompts, configuration/use guides, examples, a changelog and GitHub templates. My_Information.txt describes the tutor itself, not a participant. There are no study participants, assigned AI conditions/sequences, creativity ratings, original participant solutions, analysis scripts or tabular research data in the listed files. Generic prompt examples are not participant texts. The README says DISCONTINUED. No LICENSE file appears in the complete tree and no license is specified in the README; license is therefore null. This finding establishes public tool materials only and cannot supply the missing study statistics.

Exact related-source quote (c246, PDF p. 5 / printed p. 169, GenAI feedback conditions; not a statement from c041): In contrast, the personalised GenAI condition used Mr. Ranedeer, an open-source personalised AI tutor available on the OpenAI platform (https://chat.openai.com/g/g-9PKhaweyb-mr-ranedeer; https://github.com/JushBJJ/Mr.-Ranedeer-AI-Tutor), which tailors feedback by integrating real-time learner input with pre-defined learning preferences.

notes:
Checked on 2026-10-09. Read the entire c041 markdown conversion in chunks: all 287 lines / 33,958 characters, including the complete reference list; also inspected the 13-page PDF's text for availability/repository/supplement terms and its hyperlink annotations. The chapter spans printed pp. 376-388, ends with references, and has no appendix, supplementary-file reference, data/code/materials availability statement, preregistration, acknowledgement with a resource link, repository link, or on-request data offer. Statements is empty for c041. Its ordinary apparatus/method descriptions do not announce a materials deposit. Both data_url and code_url in forms/c041.json are empty.

No public participant-level or output-level dataset for S1 was found. Status code_or_materials_only refers solely to the general tutor materials discovered via related report c246; it must not be interpreted as availability of a c041 replication package. The form's shared-sample link to c246 is explicitly inferential, and c041 itself neither cites c246 nor provides the GitHub URL. c246's local PDF p. 5 supplies the tutor links and its Appendix, PDF pp. 20-21 (printed pp. 184-185), contains settings and representative prompt/feedback examples, without participant IDs, arm assignments or scored participant outputs. Its form also has empty data/code URLs.

Repository searches used the named unauthenticated APIs through Python urllib with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1. DataCite: https://api.datacite.org/dois?query=<query>, page[size]=100; Harvard Dataverse: https://dataverse.harvard.edu/api/search?q=<query>&type=dataset&per_page=100; Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/api/records?q=<query>, size=25 after the initial validation errors; OSF: https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/?filter[title]=<query>&page[size]=100. Search counts are the returned totals, not counts of relevant datasets. relevant=[] means no result was confirmed as belonging to c041/S1.

The first two Zenodo requests used size=100 and returned HTTP 400 with the message that anonymous requests are limited to 25; their counts are null. The corrected size=25 requests returned HTTP 200. The first shortened-title Zenodo query timed out, so its HTTP status and result count are unknown; the later identical query returned HTTP 200 with 0 results. All other repository searches listed returned HTTP 200. OSF totals were read from links.meta.total. The publisher landing-page entry has n_results=null because a bot challenge prevented inspection.

DataCite's author query returned 196 records; both pages (100 and 96 records) returned HTTP 200 and were screened. No c041/related-report deposit was identified. Ambiguous records were checked directly: https://api.datacite.org/dois/10.6084/m9.figshare.25270216 (HTTP 200) describes cell-shape data; https://api.datacite.org/dois/10.60893/figshare.apl.29893589 (HTTP 200) describes Sb2S3 solar-cell materials. Neither belongs to this study. The c246 publisher page identifies Yixuan Chen's ORCID as 0009-0005-1751-5267; searching that identifier returned 0 DataCite records. Zenodo's 9 given-name-first results are unrelated taxonomic records; its 12 reverse-name results concern other research/materials, including authors with other ORCIDs.

The broader OSF title search personalized returned 314 records across four HTTP-200 pages (100, 100, 100, 14); titles were screened and plausible candidates checked through node metadata. https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/kzuge/ describes CreativityBot, a different two-part DAT/AUT/product-selection/advertisement study; its contributors endpoint (HTTP 200) names Sean Kelley and Christoph Riedl. https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/5kxv8/ identifies work by Kreisberg-Nitzav and Kenett. https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/wng8d/ concerns an AI-trust dissertation, and its contributor is Gebing Wang. https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/3m2kj/ is an AIED 2026 paper by contributor Ethan Prihar. Nodes 6uw9d and mj254 concern textbook formative practice, and ygdjm concerns corporate coaching. All seven node requests and the three contributor checks returned HTTP 200; these are unrelated leads, not c041 deposits. https://api.osf.io/v2/users/?filter[full_name]=Yixuan%20Chen&page[size]=100 returned one user, bdvxk; https://api.osf.io/v2/users/bdvxk/nodes/?page[size]=100 returned one public project about Chinese COVID-19 vaccine-trial publication, not this experiment. Searching a person's name with OSF's title filter is only a title search; the separate users/nodes check addresses that limitation.

Link checks: https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-981-95-4499-8_31 returned HTTP 200 but only a Client Challenge asking for JavaScript. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-981-95-4499-8_31 also ended at a Springer Client Challenge (final HTTP 200). Stopped without attempting to bypass it, so publisher-hosted supplementary data cannot be ruled out. The PDF p. 1 Crossmark annotation, http://crossmark.crossref.org/dialog/?doi=10.1007/978-981-95-4499-8_31&domain=pdf, returned final HTTP 200 after an HTTPS redirect. The malformed p. 1 DOI annotation https://doi.org/10.1007/978-981-95-4499-8sb%20%7B31%7D returned HTTP 404; the correctly printed DOI was checked separately. The only other printed URL, https://doi.org/10.1007/BF03078234 in the References on PDF p. 12 (printed p. 387), ended at a Springer Client Challenge with final HTTP 200; it is a cited feedback article, not a study-data link.

The related report landing page https://ajet.org.au/index.php/AJET/article/view/11512 returned HTTP 200, showed the matching title/authors and an article PDF link, and supplied no supplementary-data link. The c246 tutor link https://chat.openai.com/g/g-9PKhaweyb-mr-ranedeer returned final HTTP 200 at https://chatgpt.com/g/g-9PKhaweyb-mr-ranedeer with a login interface; stopped there. This is a hosted intervention tool, not a deposit of research data, and is not counted separately among deposits. No login, account creation, access request or bot-check bypass was attempted; no remote file was saved.

No public data were available to establish how the three solutions were aggregated into each person's creativity score, reproduce or explain the discrepant Wilcoxon r values across reports, determine paired precision, or resolve the self-efficacy error bars in final.open_items. Participant-level means/SDs/SEs, outcome-specific analyzed counts, within-person covariance and diversity measures from original ideas cannot be computed from the located material. what_we_could_compute is null. Confidence is medium because the publisher supplement check was blocked and a negative repository search cannot prove that no unindexed or differently titled deposit exists.
